# Doors, ladders, stairs, cave entrances, shortcuts, boats, portals and levers, from the Shortest Path
# RuneLite plugin (github.com/Skretzo/shortest-path), BSD 2-Clause.
# "@ name" lines are the names, numbered from 0. Other lines: from x y plane, to x y plane, ticks,
# goes somewhere far or into another area (1/0), name number, requirement number (-1 = none),
# estimate (1/0). "% requirement" lines are the requirements, numbered from 0.
# Plus joins into areas the walking map has no way into, from obstacle locations in the Golems Don't Die
# RuneLite plugin (github.com/Varzeki/golems-dont-die), BSD 2-Clause, and cave entrances checked against the
# crowdsourced transport data of the RuneScape map project (github.com/mejrs/data_osrs).
